cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Core words: When?.

words.en: We go to the park after school.
more: Dad reads a book after dinner.
Max sleeps on the sofa after lunch.
Max 午饭后在沙发上睡觉。

words.en: We play football, and afterwards we eat.
words.sz: 我们踢足球，然后吃东西。
more: Mum cooks dinner, and afterwards she rests.
妈妈做晚饭，随后她休息。
Tom does his homework, and afterwards he plays.

words.en: Lily reads the story again.
words.sz: Lily 又读了一遍这个故事。
more: Max runs after the ball again.

words.en: Grandma visited us two days ago.
words.sz: 奶奶两天前来看我们了。
more: I saw Tom five minutes ago.
我五分钟前看见 Tom 了。
We moved here one year ago.

words.en: Tom has already finished his homework.
We always eat breakfast at seven.
words.sz: 我们总是在七点吃早饭。
more: Mum always helps me with maths.
妈妈总是帮我做数学题。
Max always runs to the door when I come home.
我回家时 Max 总是跑到门口。

words.en: Wash your hands before you eat.
more: Lily brushes her teeth before bed.
We check the map before we drive.

words.en: The film starts at the beginning of August.
more: It is hard at the beginning.
We learn new words at the beginning of the lesson.
我们在课程开始时学新单词。

words.en: It rains during the school day.
more: We listen to music during lunch.
Max makes a loud noise during the storm.
暴风雨期间 Max 发出很大的声音。

words.en: Dad wakes up early in the morning.
more: We leave home early for the train.
我们很早离开家去赶火车。
The shop opens early on Saturday.

words.en: The school day ends at three o'clock.
more: We walk to the end of the street.
The story has a happy end.
这个故事有一个快乐的结局。

words.en: Do you ever eat fish for breakfast?
more: Is this the best ice cream ever?
这是最好吃的冰淇淋吗？
I never saw such a big dog.
我从来没见过这么大的狗。

words.en: Lily plays in the final match.
words.sz: Lily 参加最后一场比赛。
more: The final game is on Sunday.
最后一场比赛在星期日。

words.en: Finally, the rain stops.
more: We finally arrived at Grandma's house.
Tom finally found his red shoe.
Tom 终于找到了他的红鞋子。

words.en: First of all, wash your hands.
more: First of all, we need a map.
首先，我们需要一张地图。
First of all, put on your coat.

words.en: What will you do in the future?
more: 未来看起来很令人兴奋。
Maybe people will live on the moon in the future.
也许将来人们会住在月球上。

words.en: Dad is late for work.
more: It's too late to go out.
Tom is never late for school.

words.en: I'll see you later, Max!
more: We can play later after homework.
做完作业后我们可以稍后再玩。

words.en: This is the latest news.
more: 最新的一部电影是什么？

words.zh: 午餐时间；中午休息时间
words.en: We eat sandwiches at lunchtime.
words.sz: 我们在午餐时间吃三明治。
more: Lunchtime is from one to two o'clock.
午餐时间是从一点到两点。
Tom is always hungry at lunchtime.
Tom 一到午饭时间就饿。

words.en: The sun is high at midday.
more: It's very hot at midday in summer.

words.en: Tom never eats vegetables.
more: I never go to bed late.

words.en: We are playing now.
We often go to the park.
I went to London once.
more: We visit Grandma once a month.
我们每个月去看奶奶一次。

words.en: Grandma visited us recently.
more: Mia moved to our street recently.
Mia 最近搬到了我们这条街。

words.en: I have known Mia since I was six.
words.sz: 我六岁就认识 Mia 了。
more: 从早上起就一直在下雨。
We have had Max since he was small.
Max 从小我们就养着他了。

words.en: We sometimes eat out.
The bus is coming soon.
Mum is still working.
Suddenly, the lights went out.
more: Max suddenly ran to the door.

words.en: First wash your hands, then eat.
more: We had tea, then we played games.
我们喝了茶，然后玩了游戏。

words.en: Wait here till I come back.
more: The shop is open till six o'clock.

words.en: Dad worked until late last night.
more: We stayed until the rain stopped.
Don't go until Dad comes home.

words.en: Lily goes swimming twice a week.
more: Tom brushes his teeth twice a day.
She visited Grandma twice last month.
上个月她去看望了奶奶两次。

words.en: We usually have cereal for breakfast.
more: Dad is usually home by six.

words.en: This is the usual bus stop.
more: He arrived at his usual time.
She wore her usual red coat.
她穿了那件平常的红色外套。

words.en: Have you finished your homework yet?
more: The letter has not arrived yet.
I have not watched that film yet.

words.en: Call Dad immediately if you are lost.
words.sz: 如果你迷路了，立刻给爸爸打电话。
more: Max ran to the door immediately.

words.en: Tom talks all the time.
more: She is happy all the time.
It rains all the time in winter.

words.en: Autumn is my favourite season.
words.sz: 秋天是我最喜欢的季节。
more: Spring is a nice season for flowers.

words.en: Check your timetable for maths.
words.sz: 看看你的课程表找数学课。
more: The train timetable is on the wall.
My school timetable starts at eight.
我的学校课程表八点钟开始。

words.en: Tom doesn't cry anymore.
It was my last day at school.
words.sz: 那是我上学期的最后一天。
more: Last week we went to the park.
He was the last one to leave.

words.en: Next week is my birthday.
more: Who is next in the line?
